verdict: Leads surged this week, but key infrastructure milestones remain overdue.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 101 leads from Meta at a cost of $13.30 per lead — and over the most recent 7 days, lead volume jumped 87.5% while cost per lead dropped 44%, both on nearly flat spend. That momentum is encouraging, though the daily pace has softened in the last few days and the mid-October peak has not been matched again. Separately, 10 planned milestones — including landing pages, conversion tracking, search campaigns, and nurture sequences — remain incomplete, which means web-layer lead data is not yet verifiable and several planned channels are still off. Work is underway to move these items to completion; as each goes live, your reporting will become more complete and additional lead sources will activate.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all from Meta
cost per lead this period, down 44% from the prior 7-day window
Google Business Profile actions (calls, directions, website clicks) this period

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions fell 25% week-over-week, with the last two days showing zero actions — offline demand is not keeping pace with rising paid lead volume.
watch_item.fix: We are monitoring GBP engagement daily and cross-referencing against paid lead trends to determine whether this reflects a reporting lag or a genuine dip in local intent.
